import numpy as np, pandas as pd, cv2
din = pd.read_csv("/app/demo_metadata.csv")
dout = pd.read_csv("/app/scratch/out_dir/demo_metadata.csv")
img = cv2.imread("/app/demo_rgb.png"); H, W = img.shape[:2]
ious = []
for i in range(len(din)):
    ri, ro = din.iloc[i], dout.iloc[i]
    def rast(r):
        cx = np.array([int(v) for v in str(r.coords_x).split(",")])
        cy = np.array([int(v) for v in str(r.coords_y).split(",")])
        m = np.zeros((H,W), np.uint8)
        cv2.fillPoly(m, [np.stack([cx,cy],1).reshape(-1,1,2)], 1)
        return m
    a, b = rast(ri), rast(ro)
    iou = (a&b).sum() / max(1,(a|b).sum())
    ious.append(iou)
ious = np.array(ious)
print("IoU input vs output: mean %.3f min %.3f max %.3f" % (ious.mean(), ious.min(), ious.max()))
print("rows with IoU < 0.3:", [i for i in range(len(ious)) if ious[i] < 0.3])
# how many changed at all
print("rows where output bbox == input bbox:", sum(1 for i in range(len(din))
      if din.iloc[i][["xmin","ymin","xmax","ymax"]].astype(int).tolist() == dout.iloc[i][["xmin","ymin","xmax","ymax"]].astype(int).tolist()))

import numpy as np, pandas as pd, cv2
dout = pd.read_csv("scratch/out_dir/demo_metadata.csv")
img = cv2.imread("demo_rgb.png"); H, W = img.shape[:2]
maxdiff = 0
for i in range(len(dout)):

    cx = np.array([int(v) for v in str(r.coords_x).split(",")])
    cy = np.array([int(v) for v in str(r.coords_y).split(",")])
    m = np.zeros((H,W), np.uint8)
    cv2.fillPoly(m, [np.stack([cx,cy],1).reshape(-1,1,2)], 1)
    # re-extract outer contour and re-fill; must be identical
    cnts,_ = cv2.findContours(m, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_NONE)
    m2 = np.zeros((H,W), np.uint8)
    cv2.fillPoly(m2, [c.reshape(-1,1,2) for c in cnts], 1)
    d = int((m != m2).sum())
    maxdiff = max(maxdiff, d)
    if d: print("row", i, "diff", d)
print("max fill roundtrip diff:", maxdiff)
